q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Net sales rose by ₹8,423 (4.8%) week-on-week — driven mainly by more orders (+10%) and a small AOV gain, even though ad spend fell materially (-16%). Measured.

Evidence
- Net sales: Previous 2026-10-09..2026-10-11 = ₹174,195 → This 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 = ₹182,618 (change +₹8,423, +4.8%) — Measured.
- Orders: 88 → 97 (change +9, +10.2%) — Measured.
- Net AOV: ₹2,404.2 → ₹2,478.4 (change +₹74.2, +3.1%) — Measured.
- Ad spend (paid_media view): ₹145,266.9 → ₹121,390.2 (change −₹23,876.7, −16.4%) — Measured.

Why this likely happened
- Primary driver: higher order volume (+10%) accounted for most of the net-sales increase (exact split shown above) — Measured.
- Secondary driver: modest increase in AOV amplified the uplift — Measured.
- Efficiency improved: ad spend fell ~16% while sales rose, implying better spend efficiency or a shift to lower-cost channels/campaigns — Hypothesis (requires channel/campaign drilldown to confirm).
- Next suspected causes (hypotheses to test): campaign/creative reallocation, strong organic/retention orders, or a small set of campaigns producing disproportionately more orders with lower spend per order.

Period: 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 vs 2026-10-09..2026-10-11 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14.
